name: generic
description: Full image (registry, repository, tag) and checksum (digest) of OpenShift workloads, from the running pods or skopeo inspect; select workloads by name, tag or container patterns.
author: Aravinthan Selvaraj

arguments.name: mode
arguments.description: pod: from the running pods (the digest actually running). skopeo: skopeo inspect of each workload's image. auto: pods, and skopeo for workloads with no running pod.

arguments.name: environment
arguments.description: OpenShift environment whose oc.generic login session is used (log in with oc.generic first). Not needed when only 'images' are inspected.

arguments.name: namespace
arguments.description: OpenShift project to read; the session's current project when empty.

arguments.name: deployments
arguments.description: Workload name pattern(s): glob, or re:REGEX. Only matching workloads are read.

arguments.name: tags
arguments.description: Image tag pattern(s); only images whose tag matches are returned.

arguments.name: containers
arguments.description: Container name pattern(s); only matching containers are returned.

arguments.name: rules
arguments.description: Selection rules, any of which may match: objects with deployments, tags and containers patterns that must all match. The deployments/tags/containers arguments form one more rule.

arguments.name: kinds
arguments.description: Workload kinds read: deployment, deploymentconfig, statefulset, daemonset.

arguments.name: images
arguments.description: Image references to inspect with skopeo directly (no OpenShift needed); the tags patterns apply.

arguments.name: credentials
arguments.description: Registry login for skopeo: username and password (or token). Written to a temporary owner-only auth file, never to a command line.

arguments.name: authfile
arguments.description: Existing registry auth file for skopeo (instead of credentials).

arguments.name: tls_verify
arguments.description: Verify registry TLS certificates in skopeo.

arguments.name: timeout
arguments.description: Seconds allowed for each skopeo inspect.

arguments.name: generate
arguments.description: Write <namespace>-<YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS>.txt with one image:checksum line per image (registry/repository:tag:sha256:...); it is added to Artifacts (Generated).

arguments.name: output_directory
arguments.description: Where the generated file is written. Default: the plugin's data folder, generated/.

arguments.name: fail_on_error
arguments.description: Fail the step when an image cannot be inspected.

outputs.name: namespace
outputs.description: Project read (empty for the session's current one).

outputs.name: images
outputs.description: One entry per container image: namespace, kind, deployment, container, image (registry/repository:tag), registry, repository, tag, digest, reference (registry/repository@digest), source (pod or skopeo), pods.

outputs.name: deployments
outputs.description: Workloads with selected containers (resolved, or listed in missing/errors).

outputs.name: digests
outputs.description: deployment -> container -> {image, digest}; a list when running pods differ (during a rollout).

outputs.name: missing
outputs.description: deployment/container with no running pod (mode pod).

outputs.name: errors
outputs.description: Images skopeo could not inspect, with the reason.

outputs.name: file
outputs.description: Path of the generated image:checksum file (empty unless generate is true).
